fetch._comment_reader: agent-reach 'web' channel. The x-timeout header is REQUIRED: without it the reader returns the pre-hydration page shell and every price field comes back empty. Validated 2026-08-15.

sources.notes: Best source: labelled Lowest/Average/Highest, MRP, and dated drop events. 403s to plain fetch, fine through the reader.
ASIN-keyed URLs, so an Amazon link resolves directly. Publishes its own above/below-average call, useful as a cross-check.
Gives all-time low/high plus a 30-day average, and renders current+MRP adjacently.
Thinner. Stats render only after hydration; weight reduced because it often reports a flat band.

pre_sale_hike.trigger: price rose > 5% within 30 days before the sale

never_was_price.trigger: claimed MRP never observed at or above in any source history or the ledger

recycled_discount.trigger: the same drop price recurs >= 3 times in 12 months

legal_basis.instrument: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

scope.out_of_scope_reason: Variant-heavy fashion SKUs have unstable identity across trackers; Croma/Reliance Digital are thinly covered by all four sources.
